set.body:
Objective
Create the empty transform module and the acyclic edges the design needs.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (Phase 0, D0). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
build; build.sbt, README.md, modules/transform. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. modules/transform {shared,jvm,js} with package scalafim.transform; depends on image and reframe4s lie/field/resample; spatial and atlas depend on it; atlas -> spatial edge added; no cycles.
2. transformBoundaryCheck task wired before transform/Compile/compile, mirroring imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck.
3. munit and munit-scalacheck on transform (and image if property tests land there).
4. scalafimCompileAll/scalafimTestAll aggregates, aliases and README module blurb updated.

Verification
Bounded sbt batches: <module>JVM/test then <module>JS/test for touched modules; scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. transformJVM/test and transformJS/test run an empty-but-present suite.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P0.02: Build skeleton: transform crossProject, new edges, transformBoundaryCheck, test deps
